title: cEDH deck candidate v2
description: A generator-produced Commander deck candidate accepted by commander_simulator. Schema validity is necessary but not sufficient: the service also verifies that library quantities sum to exactly 99, that deck_sha256 independently recomputes from the submitted list, and that the requested strategy pack is installed and supports the commander.
$comment: v2 REPLACES v1's candidate_hash, which hashed the deck list together with the requested strategy pack under a name that read like a deck identity. Two consumers could not both be right about what it meant, so a deck-identity comparison against it reported 'different deck' for an identical deck built under a different pack. deck_sha256 covers the deck list and nothing else (sorted commander oracle IDs, then the coalesced library sorted by oracle ID, with quantities). Everything that affects the numbers is fingerprinted separately by simulation_input_sha256 on the result, where the RESOLVED pack is known. candidate_id, provenance and user_constraints are non-semantic and excluded from both. Preimage and vectors: contracts/hash-golden-vectors.json.

strategy_pack_id.description: The pack the producer is ASKING for. Not part of deck_sha256.

deck_sha256.description: sha256 over 'C:<oracle_id>\n' for each commander oracle_id in sorted order, then '<oracle_id>:<quantity>\n' for each library entry sorted by oracle_id. Identifies the LIST only: not the pack, not the requester, not the run. The simulator recomputes this and refuses a mismatch.

user_constraints.description: Opaque producer/UI constraints retained for audit. The simulator must not interpret this object or let it affect mechanics, and it is excluded from every hash.
